- [IFASCON 2026](http://localhost/sabir/zinvos/event/ifascon-2026/): IFASCON 2026 marks the 39th Annual Conference of the Indian Foot and Ankle Society, India’s premier gathering for foot and ankle surgeons, orthopedic specialists, and allied professionals\. This edition will be held from August 20–23, 2026, at Hotel Radisson Red, Chandigarh, offering a vibrant platform for global learning and collaboration in foot and ankle care\.
